answer: The delta index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 758 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the echo queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. A 340 account operation therefore ties up 37 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
